mapper.select: SELECT tss.*, EXISTS (SELECT * FROM travel_collect WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 2 AND data_id = tss.id) as isCollect, (SELECT count(*) FROM travel_collect WHERE type = 2 AND data_id = tss.id) as collectNum FROM travel_scenic_spot tss where tss.name like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') or tss.location like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') ORDER BY create_time DESC
